title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing adoption spreads and changes within a population under social influence, policies, supply constraints, and messaging.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People influence each other's mask adoption through network contacts and peer discussions.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Authority mandates and enforcement at locations affect individuals’ compliance and adoption decisions.

interactions.name: purchase_masks
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from retailers subject to stock and price.

interactions.name: exposure_to_messaging
interactions.description: Individuals are exposed to public health campaigns and media messages that adjust trust and risk perception.

interactions.name: visit_location
interactions.description: Individuals visit locations (household, workplace, public spaces) where rules, risk, and social norms shape wearing behavior.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Mask adoption fraction at the end of the simulation period.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption reaches 50%.

metrics.name: compliance_rate_in_mandated_areas
metrics.description: Share of visits to mandate-active locations where masks are worn.

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across subgroups (e.g., SES or age), e.g., measured by Gini or between-group difference.

metrics.name: noncompliance_incidents_per_day
metrics.description: Count of enforcement-relevant noncompliance events per day.

metrics.name: cumulative_masks_purchased
metrics.description: Total number of masks purchased by the population over time.

metrics.name: cost_burden_per_capita
metrics.description: Average monetary cost of masks per person.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_bounds
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rates remain within [0, 1] for all subgroups and times.

validation_criteria.name: stock_nonnegative
validation_criteria.description: Retailer mask stock never becomes negative.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_check
validation_criteria.description: Change in adoption rate over the last 7 days is below a small epsilon (e.g., < 0.005) if convergence is expected.

validation_criteria.name: target_threshold_optional
validation_criteria.description: If a target adoption threshold and deadline are provided, adoption meets or exceeds the target by the specified day.
